meta.title: Alexis Barber · Home barber service in Barcelona
meta.desc: Barber at home in Barcelona. Alexis comes to your flat with everything: cut, fade and beard, no travelling and no waiting. He speaks castellano, català, english, português and deutsch.
meta.ogTitle: Alexis Barber · Home barber service in Barcelona
meta.ogDesc: Your barber comes to you. Cuts, fades and beard trims at home in Barcelona, in five languages.

wa.msg: Hi Alexis, I'd like to book a haircut at home.

hero.lede: A proper barbershop cut, fade and beard trim — in your own living room. No travelling, no waiting room, at a time that actually suits you.
hero.langsNota: Pick your language and the site follows

steps.d: Tell me what you want done and which part of Barcelona you live in. No forms, no sign-ups.

steps.t: We pick a day and time
steps.d: We find the slot that works for you. Evenings, weekends and last-minute emergencies.
I arrive with clippers, scissors, cape and everything else. All you need is a chair.

servicios.h2: What I can do for you
servicios.lede: Fixed prices, no surprises. Travel within Barcelona city is included.
servicios.nota: Several people in the same flat? There's a group rate — just ask me on WhatsApp.

corte.d: Scissor or clipper cut, styled with a proper barbershop finish.

corte-barba.d: The full thing: cut plus a razor beard line-up.

barba.d: Trim, line-up and close razor shave. Oil and balm included.

infantil.d: For the little ones, at home and stress-free. Up to 12 years old.

rapado.d: Single guard all over, clean and quick.

items.d: Castellano, català, english, português and deutsch. If you've just moved to Barcelona and struggle to explain how you want your hair, that won't happen here.
If leaving the house is the hard part, I'll come to you. Older clients, recovery after surgery or reduced mobility: no transport to arrange, nobody to depend on.
No turning up to find three people ahead of you. Your slot is your slot.
At home they're relaxed, surrounded by their own things, without the barbershop stress.
I arrive, I work, and I leave it spotless. You won't sweep a single hair.

zona.lede: I cover the whole of Barcelona city. If you're in the metropolitan area, message me anyway and we'll sort it out.

final.lede: Message me on WhatsApp and I'll tell you what I have free this week.

ld.desc: Home barber service in Barcelona. Haircuts, fades and beard trims at the client's home. Service in Spanish, Catalan, English, Portuguese and German, including home visits for people with reduced mobility.
